title: Support Desk Limits for Driver Pay Adjustments (Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro)
content:
Two figures bound the missing-pay adjustments support makes on driver trips under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**. Both are the same at every Wayfare Pro status: Wayfare Pro Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite.

| Figure | Value at every status |
|---|---|
| Adjustment request window: calendar days after a trip's drop-off or cancellation within which a driver may ask for missing pay on it | 30 |
| Support credit limit: largest total support may credit to a driver for one trip without the earnings review team | 75.00 USD |

## Basis questions answered

**Is the 30-day window counted in calendar days or business days?** Calendar days, from the trip's drop-off date or, for a cancelled trip, its cancellation date.

**Is the 75.00 limit per request or per trip?** Per trip: it is the total support may credit on one trip, adding together every support credit already posted on that trip.

**Does the driver's Pro status change either figure?** No. Both figures are identical at every status.

**Hypothetical reading of the limit.** A trip that already carries a support credit of 50.00 has 25.00 of the 75.00 limit left for that trip.
